arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic, typically a binary mask (e.g. hsv_color_filter/image). Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the detected blobs

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: threshold_step
arg.description: Step of the thresholds from min_threshold to max_threshold

arg.name: min_threshold
arg.description: The minimum threshold to binarize the image

arg.name: max_threshold
arg.description: The maximum threshold (exclusive) to binarize the image

arg.name: min_repeatability
arg.description: The minimum number of the binarized images in which a blob is detected

arg.name: min_dist_between_blobs
arg.description: The blobs located closer than min_dist_between_blobs are merged

arg.name: filter_by_color
arg.description: Filter the blobs by the color of the center

arg.name: blob_color
arg.description: 0 to extract dark blobs and 255 to extract light blobs

arg.name: filter_by_area
arg.description: Filter the blobs by the area

arg.name: min_area
arg.description: The minimum area (inclusive) of the blobs [pixel]

arg.name: max_area
arg.description: The maximum area (exclusive) of the blobs [pixel]

arg.name: filter_by_circularity
arg.description: Filter the blobs by the circularity (4*pi*area/perimeter^2)

arg.name: min_circularity
arg.description: The minimum circularity (inclusive) of the blobs

arg.name: max_circularity
arg.description: The maximum circularity (exclusive) of the blobs, 1.0 means no limit

arg.name: filter_by_inertia
arg.description: Filter the blobs by the inertia ratio (minor axis / major axis, 0: line, 1: circle)

arg.name: min_inertia_ratio
arg.description: The minimum inertia ratio (inclusive) of the blobs

arg.name: max_inertia_ratio
arg.description: The maximum inertia ratio (exclusive) of the blobs, 1.0 means no limit

arg.name: filter_by_convexity
arg.description: Filter the blobs by the convexity (area / area of convex hull)

arg.name: min_convexity
arg.description: The minimum convexity (inclusive) of the blobs

arg.name: max_convexity
arg.description: The maximum convexity (exclusive) of the blobs, 1.0 means no limit
